title: GCD and LCM
description: Write a Zig program that calculates the Greatest Common Divisor and Least Common Multiple of two numbers using Euclid's algorithm.
hints: Euclid's algorithm: gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a % b), with base case b = 0 → a
LCM(a, b) = a / gcd(a, b) * b (divide first to avoid overflow)
Use recursion for a clean implementation of Euclid's algorithm
